entities.name: Edwin Arlington Robinson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edwin Arlington Robinson was an American poet and playwright. Robinson won the Pulitzer Prize for Poetry on three occasions and was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Literature four times.
